name: Boneo
intro: Boneo is a rural district inland from the southern beaches, between Rye and Cape Schanck. Paddocks, wetlands and broad roads give it a different pace from the bay towns. Boneo Discovery Park is a family stop in the area; Peninsula Hot Springs and Alba are in nearby Fingal, while RACV Cape Schanck is farther south in Cape Schanck. Use Boneo as a base for those outings, and check each operator's address and opening details before setting out.
factualLede: Boneo is a rural locality between Rye and Cape Schanck, near the Fingal thermal springs and Cape Schanck coastal attractions.

heroImage.alt: Open Boneo farmland with the Cape Schanck ridge in the distance

tldr: Boneo is rural country near Fingal's thermal springs and Cape Schanck, rather than a resort strip itself.
Best for: families considering Boneo Discovery Park, golfers and visitors wanting a rural base near the hot springs.
Signature experience: an afternoon at the maze with kids, a sundown soak, breakfast on the deck the next morning.
Two nights to do it properly; pair the soak with one of the back beaches.
Boneo is a district, not a village - there is no shop strip.
notFor: anyone wanting cafés in walking distance
signature: The quiet rural triangle that holds Peninsula Hot Springs, the Boneo Maze and Cape Schanck on three sides.
skip: Treating Boneo as a destination on its own - it is a base for the back-beach belt, not a place to wander.
bestDay: Morning at the Boneo Maze with kids, mid-afternoon at Peninsula Hot Springs, sunset drinks at RACV's bay-window bar, dinner held loosely.
insiderNote: The Maze is a much better stop than its name suggests - the wetland walk behind it is a real Peninsula nature pocket.
